Querying the west cluster for the component ocp4-workload-adv-dev-suite:

Its definition sets a default lifespan of 4h and a maximum lifespan of 24h, so a sandbox from this component is reaped after four hours unless someone extends it, and cannot be extended past a day.

It is defined from the agnosticv path agd-v2/ocp4-workload-adv-dev-suite in the rhpds/agnosticv repository, and it provisions on AWS with a single bastion instance.
